description: A collectible summary of one ecosystem artifact and its verifiable ancestry. The card is a VIEW over the artifact's receipt chain (SI ledger recipe), never a replacement for it: every claim on the card must be derivable from the chain.

head.description: Hash of the artifact chain's latest receipt; null before its first receipt is sealed.

creator.description: Who made the ORIGINAL. Never rewritten by forks.

forkCount.description: Known forks. Locally provable minimum from receipts; global counts are claims and must be labeled as such in UI.

generation.description: 0 = origin or adopted origin; +1 per fork/breed generation in-ecology.

kernelType.description: Kernel/family the artifact runs on (e.g. Phi-3.5, PoeTchi, SI Core).

foundation.description: The foundation mark, e.g. 'Created from N8 Foundation' or 'Adopted into N8 Foundation'.

genesis.description: created = born in the ecology ('Created from N8 Foundation'); adopted = brought in from upstream, ancestry preserved and adoption receipted.

parents.description: Parents in derivation order. Grandparents are reached by walking the parents' own cards/chains — the living tree.

chainRef.description: Hash of the parent's chain head at derivation time, when the parent is in-ecology.

seq.description: Ledger seq of the receipt that records this mutation.

source.description: Where the artifact's substance comes from. For downloadable artifacts: the ORIGINAL upstream only.

title: Capsule Lineage Card v1
